calendar-bot: Invite: https://calendar.example.com/e/3951234567 (Zoom link in invite).

Zoe (Eng): CLI snippet if asked:
```
redwoodctl set batching.max_batch 64
redwoodctl deploy inference
```

Pri (Product): please surface any rollout blockers in the thread so we can triage.

(After meeting) calendar-bot: Recording + slides are live -> https://videos.example.com/3951234567 and https://drive.example.com/3951234567-slides.pdf

Lina (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR: 1) Autopilot canary next week, phased rollout; 2) debug-log retention default reduced to 30 days (Dedicated can request extensions via support); 3) console dark-mode opt-in; 4) p95 latency improved after KV cache. Actions and owners in the follow-up doc.

Omar (CEO): Thanks all. Great cross-team work.
